model.name: RbStrip.applyViewportMode impl
model.description: R31.5.4: RbStrip.applyViewportMode(mode:'landscape'|'portrait') @ rb-strip.ts. Sets data-mode → app.css branches LANDSCAPE (flex; overflow:visible) vs PORTRAIT (overflow-x:auto; scroll-snap-type:x mandatory; compartments=snap-targets scroll-snap-align:start, bars ride the leading edge; --rb-peek:12vw → 88vw compartment min-width). Focus-restore: scrollIntoView the ACTIVE compartment on a real landscape↔portrait flip. observeContainer (private) = ResizeObserver container-query driver (composes when nested).
